C0753.title: U.S. Critical Infrastructure Cyber Incident Reporting Act of 2022
C0753.summary: In March 2022, the U.S. Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act (CIRCIA) was signed into law as part of an appropriations act. CISA says the law requires it to develop rules for covered entities to report covered cyber incidents and ransomware payments so CISA can assist victims, analyze cross-sector trends, share warnings with defenders, and coordinate earlier mitigation for attacks affecting critical infrastructure.
